boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented study environments in Folsom Library, including collaborative seating, subdued upper floors, group rooms, and an interview room.

cards.title: Folsom’s First-Floor Open Seating
cards.subtitle: Folsom Library · First floor
cards.notes: Set up here when collaboration is part of the plan. Keep audio on headphones and move private calls outside or into stairwells.
cards.short_summary: An open, collaborative Folsom option near the building’s main activity areas.
cards.evidence_claim: RPI Libraries identifies Folsom’s first floor as an open, collaborative space and documents study seating on that floor.
cards.source_title: Quiet Spaces, Food, and Drink | Rensselaer Libraries
cards.access_notes: Folsom requires an RPI ID to open the front doors; visitors may request entry through the exterior intercom and may need photo ID.

cards.title: Folsom’s Second-Floor Open Seating
cards.subtitle: Folsom Library · Second/main floor
cards.notes: Use this main-floor setting for shared work or a shorter session. Bring headphones and keep conversations considerate of nearby users.
cards.short_summary: Collaborative seating on Folsom’s second, or main, floor.
cards.evidence_claim: RPI Libraries identifies Folsom’s first and second (main) floors as open, collaborative spaces and documents study seating on the second floor.
cards.source_title: Quiet Spaces, Food, and Drink | Rensselaer Libraries
cards.access_notes: Folsom requires an RPI ID to open the front doors; visitors may request entry through the exterior intercom and may need photo ID.

cards.title: Third-Floor Perimeter Seating
cards.subtitle: Folsom Library · Third floor
cards.notes: Choose a perimeter table or carrel for individual work. This upper-floor setting offers wireless and/or Ethernet service in much of the seating.
cards.short_summary: Upper-floor open seating with documented network access and a subdued-study expectation.
cards.evidence_claim: RPI Libraries states that much of Folsom’s third-floor perimeter seating offers wireless and/or Ethernet service; the third floor has a subdued-discussion expectation.
cards.source_title: Meeting and Study Spaces | Rensselaer Libraries
cards.access_notes: Third-floor open areas are intended for subdued discussion. Folsom entry normally requires an RPI ID; visitors use the exterior intercom.

cards.title: Fourth-Floor Perimeter Seating
cards.subtitle: Folsom Library · Fourth floor
cards.notes: Bring a laptop and settle into the perimeter seating for focused work. Keep discussion subdued and use headphones for anything with audio.
cards.short_summary: A fourth-floor open-seating option with documented wireless and/or Ethernet coverage.
cards.evidence_claim: RPI Libraries states that much of Folsom’s fourth-floor perimeter seating offers wireless and/or Ethernet service; the fourth floor has a subdued-discussion expectation.
cards.source_title: Meeting and Study Spaces | Rensselaer Libraries
cards.access_notes: Fourth-floor open areas are intended for subdued discussion. Folsom entry normally requires an RPI ID; visitors use the exterior intercom.

cards.entity_name: Folsom Library Third-Floor Reservable Group Study Rooms
cards.title: Third-Floor Reservable Group Rooms
cards.subtitle: Folsom Library · Third floor
cards.notes: Reserve ahead when your group needs a defined work session. Keep the room’s discussion level subdued and arrive ready to share the table.
cards.short_summary: Reservable group-study rooms on Folsom’s third floor.
cards.evidence_claim: RPI Libraries states that several reservable group study rooms are located on the third and fourth floors of Folsom Library.
cards.source_title: Meeting and Study Spaces | Rensselaer Libraries
cards.access_notes: Use the Libraries’ online reservation system for library spaces. Third-floor discussions should be subdued.

cards.entity_name: Folsom Library Fourth-Floor Reservable Group Study Rooms
cards.title: Fourth-Floor Reservable Group Rooms
cards.subtitle: Folsom Library · Fourth floor
cards.notes: Book this option for planned group work, then keep conversation low. Check the online reservation system before heading to the fourth floor.
cards.short_summary: A reservable upper-floor group-room setting at Folsom.
cards.evidence_claim: RPI Libraries states that several reservable group study rooms are located on the third and fourth floors of Folsom Library.
cards.source_title: Meeting and Study Spaces | Rensselaer Libraries
cards.access_notes: Use the Libraries’ online reservation system for library spaces. Fourth-floor discussions should be subdued.

cards.entity_name: Folsom Library First-Floor Unlocked Small Group Study Rooms
cards.title: First-Floor Small Group Rooms
cards.subtitle: Folsom Library · First floor
cards.notes: Check an unlocked room for a small-group session without a reservation. Be ready to relocate if a group requests the room for use.
cards.short_summary: First-come, first-use small-group rooms on Folsom’s first floor.
cards.evidence_claim: RPI Libraries states that small group study rooms on Folsom’s first, third, and fourth floors are unlocked for individual and group use on a first-come, first-use basis.
cards.source_title: Meeting and Study Spaces | Rensselaer Libraries
cards.access_notes: These rooms are first-come, first-use; individuals may be asked to relocate if a group requests use. Folsom entry normally requires an RPI ID.

cards.entity_name: Folsom Library Third-Floor Unlocked Small Group Study Rooms
cards.title: Third-Floor Small Group Rooms
cards.subtitle: Folsom Library · Third floor
cards.notes: Try an unlocked small-group room when you do not need a reservation. Keep conversation subdued and relocate if a group asks to use it.
cards.short_summary: First-come small-group rooms within Folsom’s subdued third-floor environment.
cards.evidence_claim: RPI Libraries states that small group study rooms on Folsom’s first, third, and fourth floors are unlocked for individual and group use on a first-come, first-use basis.
cards.source_title: Meeting and Study Spaces | Rensselaer Libraries
cards.access_notes: These rooms are first-come, first-use; individuals may be asked to relocate if a group requests use. Third-floor discussions should be subdued.

cards.entity_name: Folsom Library Fourth-Floor Unlocked Small Group Study Rooms
cards.title: Fourth-Floor Small Group Rooms
cards.subtitle: Folsom Library · Fourth floor
cards.notes: Use an unlocked room for a small group that can work at a low volume. It is first-come, so have a backup plan if it is occupied.
cards.short_summary: A first-come small-group room option on Folsom’s fourth floor.
cards.evidence_claim: RPI Libraries states that small group study rooms on Folsom’s first, third, and fourth floors are unlocked for individual and group use on a first-come, first-use basis.
cards.source_title: Meeting and Study Spaces | Rensselaer Libraries
cards.access_notes: These rooms are first-come, first-use; individuals may be asked to relocate if a group requests use. Fourth-floor discussions should be subdued.

cards.title: Folsom’s Interview Room
cards.subtitle: Folsom Library
cards.notes: Reserve this room when you need a dedicated place for a virtual interview. Plan ahead through the library’s reservation process before your appointment.
cards.short_summary: A Folsom room specifically available for virtual interviews by reservation.
cards.evidence_claim: RPI Libraries states that individuals needing space for a virtual interview may reserve an interview room in Folsom Library.
cards.source_title: Meeting and Study Spaces | Rensselaer Libraries
cards.access_notes: This room requires a reservation. Folsom entry normally requires an RPI ID; visitors may request entry through the exterior intercom.
